mapper.select: select id, bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, item_table, item_id, purpose_location_id, lot_number, unit_code, total_quantity, is_deleted from wkf_supply_request where bus_no = #{busNo} and type_enum = #{typeEnum} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, category_enum, item_table, item_id, item_quantity, total_quantity, unit_code, lot_number, trace_no, price, total_price, profit_loss_price, purpose_location_id, purpose_type_enum, source_location_id, source_type_enum, supplier_id, practitioner_id, applicant_id, apply_time, approver_id, approval_time, reason, remake, start_time, end_time, occurrence_time, is_deleted, version, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE bus_no = #{busNo} AND type_enum = #{typeEnum} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT sr.id, sr.item_table AS itemTable, sr.item_id AS itemId, sr.item_quantity AS itemQuantity, sr.unit_code AS unitCode, sr.lot_number AS lotNumber, sr.trace_no AS traceNo, sr.price, sr.total_price AS totalPrice, sr.occurrence_time AS occurrenceTime, sr.start_time AS startTime, sr.end_time AS endTime, sr.remake, COALESCE(med.name, dev.name) AS productName, COALESCE(med.total_volume, dev.total_volume) AS specification, COALESCE(med.manufacturer_text, dev.manufacturer_text) AS manufacturer FROM wkf_supply_request sr LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition med ON sr.item_table = 'med_medication_definition' AND med.id = sr.item_id AND med.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_device_definition dev ON sr.item_table = 'adm_device_definition' AND dev.id = sr.item_id AND dev.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sr.bus_no = #{busNo} AND sr.type_enum = 'CABINET_INBOUND_RECEIPT' AND sr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sr.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE wkf_supply_request SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy} WHERE bus_no = #{busNo} AND type_enum = 'CABINET_INBOUND_RECEIPT' AND is_deleted = 0
